description: Pairs, small groups and teams. `GroupCard` is what one person's phone shows: which group they are in, who they are with, what to talk about and for how long. `GroupGrid` is the shared screen: every group with its people, where a reshuffle glides each name…

## @interlace/groups

Installed to `components/ui/games/groups.tsx`.

```tsx
import { /* … */ } from '@/components/ui/games/groups';
```

Props, a11y contract, live preview and source: https://ds.interlace.tools/c/groups

Requires the `@interlace/interlace-base` CSS baseline (installed automatically as a registry dependency). For the Interlace look, also add `@interlace/theme`.
